name: potassium nitrate
uses: Uses Helps reduce painful sensitivity of the teeth to cold, heat, acids, and sweets, or contact.
otcwarn: Do not use this product longer than 4 weeks unless recommended by a dentist or doctor. Sensitive teeth may indicate a serious problem that may need prompt care by a dentist. See your dentist if the problem persists or worsens.

src.label: Sensitivity Relief Fluoride Free
